alexcrichton opened PR #14489 from alexcrichton:fix-flaky-test-failure to bytecodealliance:main:

The test add in #14483 is causing failures in CI where a debug-style panic can be triggered depending on whether the host triggers a timeout or not. The fix here is to avoid asserting the result of a body write and to let the rest of the test determine if that was successful or not.
